news.analysis: Mahomes has now eclipses 300+ yards passing in three of his last four games and has not thrown an interception in four straight games. Mahomes connected with Xaiver Worthy and Travis Kelce twice to account for his three passing touchdowns. The Chiefs will have a short week as they take on the Bills on Thursday.
news.contents: Patrick Mahomes II completed 27-of-39 passes for 324 yards and three touchdowns in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes lived up to his fantasy hype in Week 11 as he threw for 324 yards and three touchdowns in a 34-7 win against the Arizona Cardinals. That makes three in his last four games, and his second week in a row that he has thrown for over 300 yards. Mahomes connected with seven different targets in Sunday's lopsided win, hitting tight end Travis Kelce with six catches for 74 yards and two touchdowns, and connecting with Xavier Worthy on the third TD. news.analysis: Johnson led the Chiefs' backfield with Kenneth Walker inactive again due to injury. The Chiefs have clearly trusted Johnson in his two starts, providing the rookie with 20+ carries in each outing. If Walker returns in Week 12, Johnson remains an extremely strong handcuff for fantasy managers.

He caught all four of his targets for 38 yards and has totaled 55 touches, 314 scrimmage yards and three touchdowns in two starts with Kenneth Walker III (groin) sidelined. White is looking like a fantasy cut candidate heading into a Week 12 matchup vs. the Cardinals.

Watkins did still get over on the field for more than 50% of the offensive snaps, but he's unlikely to offer much fantasy value going forward.
